purpose: test the intensity-aware remedy (the lesson of round K) on a problem it was not designed on
check: five-level convergence check (qoi_convergence_multilevel) with the class tolerances of trees.class_params, order window 0.5-5, on each variant

predictions.P0 plan: the plan grades the left re-entrant corner (1, 1), where the bending moment is larger than at (2, 1) (LOW-MEDIUM)
predictions.P1 smallest U: the energy's five-level U at n = 64 is smallest for the intensity variant among strongest, all and intensity (MEDIUM)
predictions.P2 order: the intensity variant's energy order is at least 2.5 (MEDIUM)
predictions.P3 consistency: its energy limit lies inside the uniform family's interval (MEDIUM-HIGH)
predictions.P4 cross-check: the P2 discretization on the intensity plan cross-checks the energy (MEDIUM)
predictions.P5 gain: its energy U is at least 10 times smaller than the uniform family's at the same n (LOW-MEDIUM)
